name.zh: STAR 分类权重扰动稳定性组件

decision_contract.supported_model: PyTorch classification model exposing a fixed class-order logits tensor shaped [batch, classes]
decision_contract.artifact_role: optional enhancement; not a standalone update method
decision_contract.objective: reduce KL(reference probabilities || locally worst perturbed probabilities) on currently correct replay samples
hard_preconditions: 已选择能够提供历史样本和真实类别标签的基础回放方法
模型输出可按明确 selector 取得二维分类 logits，且类别顺序和输出维度不变
回放标签是一维整数类别索引，并与 logits 类别范围一致
至少存在一个已批准的二维及以上可训练浮点参数范围
UpdatePlan 已明确 STAR 参数范围、regularization_weight、perturbation_ratio、noise_scale、ascent_steps、min_correct_samples 和随机种子策略
执行层能够在基础方法 backward 之前累积 STAR 梯度，并在同一次 optimizer.step 中合并更新
ineligible_when: 任务是回归、多标签分类、生成任务或没有明确类别概率语义
没有可重新读取的历史样本及真实类别标签
分类头、类别集合、类别顺序或输出维度发生变化
模型只允许闭式解析更新，或批准范围内没有可反向传播的二维及以上参数
基础方法不是回放式方法，且没有单独批准 STAR 所需历史样本机制
随机层和模型状态无法按照执行契约稳定控制

composition_order: compute and backward the approved base rehearsal loss
apply any approved clipping or scaler logic

classification_contract.model_output: pre-loss logits shaped [batch, classes] with classes >= 2
classification_contract.target: one integer class index per sample
classification_contract.divergence: KL(reference probabilities || perturbed probabilities), mean over eligible samples

perturbation_contract.ascent: one or more normalized gradient-ascent steps; total requested ratio is divided equally across ascent_steps
perturbation_contract.default_parameter_policy: all requires_grad floating parameters with ndim > 1
perturbation_contract.excluded_by_default: bias vectors, normalization affine vectors, frozen parameters, buffers and non-floating parameters
perturbation_contract.temporary_state: all temporary weight perturbations must be removed before return, including exceptional exits

execution_contract.model_mode_policy: STAR-only forwards run in eval mode and restore every module's previous training flag; the base method still uses the caller-configured training modes
execution_contract.gradient_policy: compute_star_gradients never changes .grad; accumulate_star_gradients adds detached STAR gradients to existing gradients and never clears them
execution_contract.skip_policy: if correct replay count is below min_correct_samples, return skipped=true with reason insufficient_correct_replay_samples and add no gradient
replan_triggers: logits or labels do not satisfy the classification contract
selected parameters are missing, frozen, one-dimensional, non-floating or disconnected from the logits
reference logits, perturbed logits, KL loss or gradients contain non-finite values
correct replay samples repeatedly fall below the approved minimum
temporary parameter restoration cannot be verified
旧任务指标退化或新任务学习受阻，超过 UpdatePlan 的批准阈值
资源开销超过批准的训练时间或显存边界
validation_requirements: 验证 STAR 调用前后模型参数逐值一致，只有 optimizer.step 才产生真实更新
分别记录回放批次大小、正确样本数、跳过原因、原始 KL、加权 STAR 损失和逐参数扰动范数
验证 STAR 梯度与基础方法梯度在同一步中累积，而不是被后续 zero_grad 覆盖
独立比较基础方法与基础方法加 STAR 的新旧数据指标和资源开销
确认评估使用独立历史验证数据，不能用 STAR 训练 KL 代替旧能力证据
limitations: v0.1 只支持单标签分类，不实现回归或多标签扩展
核心库不管理回放池、不计算基础持续学习损失、不创建优化器、不执行 optimizer.step
核心库不加载模型、checkpoint 或数据路径，也不保存训练产物
局部最坏扰动是一阶近似，不保证与未来真实参数更新方向一致
eval 模式的 STAR 前向是本项目为隔离随机层和可变缓冲区采用的明确实现策略

components.purpose: 计算并累积分类回放样本上的 STAR 一阶近似稳定性梯度，同时保证临时扰动恢复。
验证分类边界、梯度组合、正确样本跳过、参数与模式恢复、输出选择及方法卡身份。

references.citation: Eskandar et al. STAR: Stability-Inducing Weight Perturbation for Continual Learning. ICLR 2025.
Official STAR implementation, Gnomy17/STAR_CL, MIT License.
